files.PLAN.md:
# Plan: textkit helpers

## Progress

- [ ] Task 1: slugify
- [ ] Task 2: truncate (depends on nothing; do after task 1)

## Task 1: slugify

Add `slugify(text)` to `src/textkit.py`.

Acceptance criteria:
- `slugify("Hello World")` returns `"hello-world"`
- Punctuation is dropped: `slugify("Hi, there!")` returns `"hi-there"`
- Repeated separators collapse: `slugify("a  --  b")` returns `"a-b"`
- Leading and trailing separators are removed

## Task 2: truncate

Add `truncate(text, limit)` to `src/textkit.py`.

Acceptance criteria:
- Text of `limit` characters or fewer is returned unchanged
- Longer text is cut so the result, including a trailing `...`, is exactly `limit` characters
- A `limit` below 3 raises `ValueError`

run: git commit -qm 'feat: initial textkit with word_count'

assertions.cmd: test -z "$(git log --format=%s main..HEAD | grep -Ev '^(feat|fix|test|refactor)(\(.+\))?: ')" && test -n "$(git log --format=%s main..HEAD)"
python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from textkit import slugify as s; assert s('Hi, there!')=='hi-there' and s('a  --  b')=='a-b'"
